metadata.title: Product Bricks & Streams
metadata.description: Hierarchical product brick map for the digital-medication-management domain.

layerTypes.name: ui
layerTypes.description: User-facing web, mobile, backoffice, and operator experience modules.

layerTypes.name: interfaces
layerTypes.description: APIs, BFFs, and explicit service boundary interfaces exposed to clients or other systems.

layerTypes.name: worker
layerTypes.description: Background workers, event consumers, daemons, and asynchronous processing modules.

layerTypes.name: stateless service
layerTypes.description: Stateless orchestration services that aggregate other services without owning durable state.

layerTypes.name: service
layerTypes.description: Stateful services and domain service modules that own behavior, policy, workflow, data, or operations.

layerTypes.name: integration
layerTypes.description: Connectors, adapters, and integration modules for external systems, devices, or partner platforms.

moduleTypes.name: mobile component
moduleTypes.description: A mobile application user interface module.

moduleTypes.name: bff
moduleTypes.description: A backend-for-frontend module that shapes APIs for a specific client experience.

moduleTypes.name: api
moduleTypes.description: A programmatic API module exposed to product clients, partners, or other systems.

moduleTypes.name: backoffice interface
moduleTypes.description: An internal operations or administration interface module.

moduleTypes.name: message queue
moduleTypes.description: A queue module used for asynchronous communication between modules or systems.

moduleTypes.name: message consumer
moduleTypes.description: A consumer module that processes messages or events in the worker layer.

moduleTypes.name: daemon
moduleTypes.description: A background worker or daemon module.

moduleTypes.name: stateless service
moduleTypes.description: A service module that orchestrates work without owning durable state.

moduleTypes.name: stateful service
moduleTypes.description: A service module that owns or manages persistent state, such as a database, stored domain data, or durable business records.

moduleTypes.name: service
moduleTypes.description: A domain or platform service module; prefer stateful-service or stateless-service for new modules when the state boundary is known.

moduleTypes.name: integration
moduleTypes.description: A connector or adapter module for an external system, partner, device, or platform.

rootGroups.name: In-Home Dispensing
rootGroups.description: The in-home medical device: the dispensing mechanism, firmware, patient experience, connectivity, and assisted-medication video that put the right dose in the patient's hand.

subGroups.name: device-and-dispensing
subGroups.description: The dispensing mechanism, device firmware/runtime, and the patient reminder-and-confirmation experience.

bricks.name: Dose Dispensing Engine and Mechanism
bricks.description: The core in-device logic and mechanism that, at each scheduled time, verifies the correct pouch and pre-cuts and releases exactly that sachet on patient confirmation — never the wrong dose.

links.label: Evondos medicine dispensing robot
links.note: Reference device: locked cabinet, two sachet-roll capacity, pre-cut single-pouch dispensing.

layers.description: User-facing web, mobile, backoffice, and operator experience modules.

modules.name: Dispense Confirmation Button
modules.description: The large on-device confirmation control the patient presses to release the due dose.
Confirmation triggers the dispense controller to release the verified pouch.

layers.description: APIs, BFFs, and explicit service boundary interfaces exposed to clients or other systems.

modules.name: Dispense Command API
modules.description: On-device interface that accepts a verified dispense command and reports the outcome.
Delegates dispensing to the controller service.

layers.description: Stateful services and domain service modules that own behavior, policy, workflow, data, or operations.

modules.name: Dispense Controller
modules.description: Verifies the due pouch against the loaded roll and schedule, then drives the cut-and-release mechanism, recording the dispense outcome.

modules.name: Pouch Verification
modules.description: Confirms the pouch at the cut position matches the expected occasion before release, failing safe if uncertain.

modules.name: Cut-and-Release Mechanism Control
modules.description: Low-level control of the pre-cut and release actuators with jam and fault detection.

brickDependencies.description: Reads the active medication schedule to know which pouch is due at each time.
Runs on the device firmware runtime for real-time actuator control.

dataDependencies.description: System of record for each dispense event: what was released, when, and the confirmation outcome.
Reads the schedule to determine the due occasion and expected pouch.
Reads loaded-roll contents to verify the pouch at the cut position.

externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.description: The patient confirms and receives the physically dispensed dose.

bricks.name: Device Firmware and On-Device Runtime
bricks.description: The embedded firmware, real-time runtime, and secure boot/update stack that all on-device modules run on, keeping the medical device safe, updatable, and tamper-resistant.

layers.description: APIs, BFFs, and explicit service boundary interfaces exposed to clients or other systems.

modules.name: Device Runtime API
modules.description: Runtime interface that on-device services use for scheduling, I/O, and lifecycle.

layers.description: Background workers, event consumers, daemons, and asynchronous processing modules.

modules.name: Firmware Update Agent
modules.description: Applies signed over-the-air firmware and configuration updates with rollback.

layers.description: Stateful services and domain service modules that own behavior, policy, workflow, data, or operations.

modules.name: Secure Boot and Attestation
modules.description: Verifies signed firmware at boot and attests device integrity to the platform.

modules.name: Cabinet Lock Control
modules.description: Controls the physical cabinet lock so only authorized care staff can open the device.

brickDependencies.description: Receives update campaigns from fleet operations.

dataDependencies.description: Reads device identity and configuration for boot attestation and lock policy.

bricks.name: Patient Reminder and Confirmation Experience
bricks.description: The multi-sensory on-device experience — sound, light, on-screen text, and spoken instructions with a single large button — that makes it unmistakable to a frail patient which dose is due and how to take it.

layers.description: User-facing web, mobile, backoffice, and operator experience modules.

modules.name: Reminder Display and Voice
modules.description: On-screen text, indicator lights, sound, and spoken prompts that present the due dose.
Renders prompts driven by the reminder scheduler.

layers.description: Stateful services and domain service modules that own behavior, policy, workflow, data, or operations.

modules.description: Fires reminders at scheduled times, escalates prompt intensity, and tracks confirmation state per occasion.

modules.name: Accessibility Profile
modules.description: Adapts prompt modality, volume, and language to the patient's sensory and cognitive needs.

brickDependencies.description: Reads occasion times to drive reminders.

dataDependencies.description: Reads accessibility and language preferences for the patient.

externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.description: The patient perceives reminders through sight, sound, and voice.

rootGroups.name: Remote Care and Monitoring

subGroups.name: adherence-and-alarms

bricks.name: Adherence Tracking and Dose Ledger
